notes.title: New Languages Added
notes.content:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1353270/Five_Dates/

We've just updated the game to include support for three new languages! To celebrate the addition of French, German and Portuguese (BR) you can save 60% on the FMV best-seller, [b]Five Dates[/b]!

❤ "Very Positive" user reviews on Steam
❤ A completely live-action romantic comedy, directed by Paul Raschid (The Complex)
❤ Entirely conceptualized, filmed and developed during lockdown
❤ Real-time Relationship Status Tracking that influences the story as you play
❤ Multi-optional storytelling with different outcomes
❤ Starring Mandip Gill (Doctor Who), Georgia Hirst (Vikings), Sinead Harnett (singer) and Taheen Modak (Two Weeks To Live)

[h1]List of Languages Supported[/h1]
English
Spanish
Russian
Simplified Chinese
Turkish
French (New)
German (New)
Portuguese-Brazil (New)

We hope you enjoy the game and please do let us know your thoughts in the comments section! 

Love FMV? Head over to our dedicated [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/584980/discussions/0/135511655652258962/]FMV thread[/url] and tell us what your favourite FMV is!

notes.title: Valentine's & Lunar Sale!
notes.content:
To celebrate the Steam Lunar Sale plus the addition of adding support for a new language (Korean) we're offering new players 12% off for a limited time! 

Five Dates now includes support for the following languages: 

[list]
[*] English
[*] Chinese (Simplified)
[*] Turkish
[*] Korean
[/list]

Did you know? Five Dates is also coming to iOS on Valentine's Day!
